title: LEGO® The Lord of the Rings™
provenance: Reported by DCD55 (highball-db#835, 2026-10-31), Apple M5, macOS 27.2, Highball 0.10.22, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, DXVK with async shaders on, esync, a 60 fps cap, rated 4 of 5 after 33 minutes: a saved game, the open world and a story level. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Plays on DXVK on an M5. The reporter had slowdowns at first and it ran smooth after lowering some settings in the game. Not measured here.

knownIssues.symptom: Occasional slowdowns and stutters at first (M5, DXVK)
knownIssues.fix: in the game's settings turn off Depth of Field, Motion Blur and Bloom, and set textures and shadows to Low or Medium, which made it smooth for the reporter
